name: Parmenas
title: One of the seven deacons
summary: Parmenas was one of the seven men chosen to serve at the tables in the first church in Jerusalem. He was selected along with Stephen and the other deacons to ensure a fair distribution of food to the widows, so that the apostles could devote themselves to prayer and the ministry of the word.

keyEvents.title: The Choosing of the Seven
keyEvents.description: Parmenas was chosen by the church as one of seven men, known to be full of the Spirit and wisdom, to serve in the daily distribution of food.

keyEvents.title: The Apostles' Laying on of Hands
keyEvents.description: After the church had chosen the seven, Parmenas and the others were presented before the apostles, who prayed and laid their hands on them.

keyEvents.title: Growth of the Church
keyEvents.description: After the seven were appointed to serve, the word of God spread, and the number of disciples in Jerusalem increased greatly.
